data.name: Lutfiyat
data.gender_notes: Lutfiyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings beauty, pleasure or delight. The name Lutfiyat carries the meaning “Bringer of beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Lutfiyat usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the grace and beauty of Allah in one's life
data.etymology: Lutfiyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutfiyat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: لطفية
in_arabic.long_meaning: لطفية: مشتق من الجذر (ل-ط-ف) و يعني اللطف والرحمة والجمال. في الإلهام، يرمز لطفية إلى الإلهام الإلهي، بينما في الخلق، يرمز إلى الفنون الجميلة والجميل. في الإسلام، يعتبر اللطف أحد الأسماء الحسنى لله، حيث يصف رحمته و لطفته تجاه خلقه. في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية، يعتبر اسم لطفية رمزًا للموسيقى والفنون الجميلة. وفي الأوساط المتطورة من المجتمع المسلم، يعتبر اسم لطفية رمزًا للتعليم والثقافة

in_urdu.name: لطفیتہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللطف کی عظمت اور اللہ کی رحمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: لطفیتہ: اس کا ماخذ (ل-ط-ف) ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے اللطف اور رحمت اور سونے کا جیسا کہاں بھی۔اس کے ذریعے، ہماری خلیقہ اللہ تعالیٰ کے لطف اور رحمت کا پتہ چلتا ہے۔ اس کے ذریعے ہمیں اللہ کی بھلائی اور کرم کی عظمت کا پتہ چلتا ہے۔اس میں ہندوستان اور پاکستان کے مسلمانوں کے درمیان ایک عمدہ نام ہے ۔

in_hindi.name: लुत्फियत
in_hindi.long_meaning: लुत्फियत: इस नाम का मूल (ल-ट-फ) है और इसका अर्थ है अल्लाह की मेहरबानी और दया। यह नाम अल्लाह के प्यार और दया का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समाज में लुत्फियत एक लोकप्रिय और शुभ नाम है।

in_pashto.name: لطفیتا
in_pashto.long_meaning: لطفیتا: دې نوم د (ل-ط-ف) رڼځه لري، د لطف او د رحمت څخه رانيږي. په اسلامي دين کې د لطف په معنا د الهي لطف او رحمت څخه وړاندې کیږي. د لطفیتا په نوم کې د لطف او رحمت د الهي لطف او رحمت څخه رانيږي. په افغانستان او پښتني ټولنو کې د لطفیتا د نوم د لطف او رحمت څخه په معنا رامنځته کېږي.

in_english.name: Lutfiyat
in_english.meaning: Divine favor and mercy, a name representing Allah's benevolence and kindness
in_english.long_meaning: Lutfiyat is a name derived from the Arabic root (L-Ṭ-Ṗ) and means divine favor and mercy. In Islamic tradition, lutfiyat represents Allah's benevolence and kindness to His creation. It is a name that symbolizes Allah's favor and mercy. In various Muslim cultures, lutfiyat is considered a name that embodies the qualities of creativity, beauty, and kindness.

pronunciation.hindi: लुत्फियत का हिन्दी में उच्चारण विवरण

data.cultural_impact: The name "Lutfiyat" carries a deep sense of elegance and charm. It evokes images of graceful people who bring joy and comfort to those around them. In Islamic culture, the name is often given to children who are believed to possess beautiful personalities and the ability to bring happiness and delight to others.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Lutfiyat" lies in the idea of being a source of beauty and delight for God. The name suggests that the person bearing this name is striving to bring joy and pleasure to the Creator through their actions, words, and attitude. Living up to the name "Lutfiyat" means embodying the qualities of compassion, kindness, and beauty, both externally and internally, reflecting God's own attributes and bringing His presence closer.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Bringer of beauty" symbolizes One who brings beauty, pleasure or delight. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Lutfiyat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of bringer of beauty.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Lutfiyat is mentioned in the book 'Kitab al-Aghani' as a name of a woman. The name Lutfiyat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The book 'Kitab al-Aghani' is a historical collection of poetry and stories from the Islamic Golden Age.

trends: increasing popularity in the Middle East
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Lutfiyat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Khadija Lutfiyat, a teacher in Dubai, UAE, shares that their name Lutfiyat meaning "Bringer of beauty" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
